name: Encore
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Midnight Sun's mark, on Nyusha "Sable" Sintashta, the Criminal identity no other deck plays, whose first successful run on the mark each turn gains a click. Midnight Sun Stage 6a: three Carpe Diem, which run the mark; three Backstitching, which bypass the mark's ice; and two Virtuoso, which breach HQ after a run on any other mark, around Parhelion's Tunnel Vision and Info Bounty, Picket Line's money and its three breakers. Eternal-legal only: Nyusha is banned in Standard. Midnight Sun Stage 6b: three Pinhole Threading for its two Strike Fund and a Chrysopoeian Skimming, a run that accesses a root card elsewhere; Picket Line keeps both. Uprising Stage 5: two Makler for its two Marjanah, a fracter that pays a credit the first time each turn it fully breaks a piece of ice; Picket Line keeps Marjanah. Downfall Stage 3: two Bukhgalter for two Carmen, a killer that pays 2[credit] the first time each turn it fully breaks a piece of ice (banned in Standard, as Nyusha is).
